title: C/Zephyr: dad_retry seed loop (1..=255) absent; short_addr_dad.json vectors not consumed by C tests
description:
Req R-02-062 (spec/02-physical-link.md 4.5, MUST): 'Implementations MUST match test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json.' (CRC-32/IEEE poly 0xEDB88320 keyed with LICHEN init 0x4348454E; seed mixing XORs seed LE into EUI-64 bytes 4..8; collision retry seeds 1..=255.)

Classification: implemented+tested in Rust and Python; partial in C (primitives only).
Evidence: C primitives exist (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c:45-85 crc32_ieee, lichen_derive_short_addr, lichen_derive_short_addr_with_seed; LICHEN_CRC32_INITIAL 0x4348454E in ipv6_addr.h:107-111) but no dad_retry seed-retry loop anywhere in lichen/, and no C test consumes short_addr_dad.json (lichen/tests/short_addr_iid uses its own vectors.h).
Conformant: rust/lichen-core/src/short_addr.rs:23,61-94 + rust/lichen-core/tests/short_addr_vectors.rs:35,61,80 (consumes short_addr_dad.json + dad_hash_clarification.json) + retry loop rust/lichen-rpl/src/address_assignment.rs:1080; python/src/lichen/link/short_addr.py:46-171 + python/tests/test_vectors.py:4016-4676.

Suggested placement: add dad_retry (seeds 1..=255) in lichen C address assignment (l2/ipv6_addr.c or rpl path) + a C vector consumer test mirroring lichen/tests/short_addr_iid structure.
